h1: Agent maintenance, a starter round of upkeep
overview: Agents drift when tools, prices or rules change. This is a fixed starter sprint, not a monthly plan: we review your agent, check that every connection still works, update prompts and rules for what has changed, retest on your cases and hand you a short report. If you want ongoing monthly care afterwards, we quote that separately.

faq: No. It is a one-time starter sprint with a fixed price and scope. If you want monthly care after it, we quote that separately based on how much your agent changes.
Can you maintain an agent you did not build?
Usually yes, with collaborator access to the tools it uses. We review it first and tell you plainly if it is too hard to maintain safely and what a rebuild would involve.
What usually breaks in an agent?
Tool connections that expire, websites that change layout, model versions that get retired and rules that no longer match your business. The health check looks at each of these.
Do I pay for model and tool changes?
Our price covers the work. Any new subscriptions or higher usage costs are billed to you by the providers, and we flag them before making a change that would add cost.
